summary: VisionSys AI Inc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of a general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 26, 2026. The meeting agenda includes proposals to increase authorized share capital by creating 250 billion Class A ordinary shares, adopt amended articles of association, and designate the meeting as the annual general meeting to ratify fiscal year 2025 audited financials. This is a routine corporate governance filing for an offshore issuer (Cayman Islands) listed on NASDAQ. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. The filing is purely administrative and procedural, warranting classification as None.
